deductions.reason: Still one file for layout, tray, guard, viewer, IPC; splitting into layout.js / tray.js / viewer.js remains the right structure move.
Note/IngestResult typedefs now exist but individual functions in main.js/store.js are still unannotated; the contract lives in one file, not at the call sites.
Deadline editor still swaps to an unstyled native date input that visually clashes with the card.

Edge guard still spawns an osascript subprocess every 1.2s while notes are pinned; event-driven detection isn't possible without native helpers, but the interval could back off when the frontmost app hasn't changed.
Still no keyboard operability: no shortcuts for close/done/expand/step, and cards can't be tabbed between.
